evals.prompt: We suspect our ERP materials table has lots of duplicates — different people entered the same bolt or bearing over the years under slightly different descriptions. Can you find them and give me a file with the candidate duplicate pairs?
evals.expected_output: Runs the SOP: verifies/embeds the materials table into chunk_embeddings (real embedding endpoint if configured, mock otherwise), runs find_similar_materials.sh to produce a JSONL dataset, and filters candidates on matched_fields containing part_no before presenting results.

evals.prompt: Generate some realistic sample material data with known duplicates baked in so I can demo the dedup pipeline to my team. Keep it small enough to run in a few minutes.
evals.expected_output: Runs seed_materials.py with a reduced ROWS value (e.g. ROWS=2000) and non-default DUPE_PCT, reports the injected cluster counts, and explains that variants share brand/part_no/spec/dims with corrupted descriptions.

evals.prompt: Our Ollama box is at http://gpu-box.lan:11434 with bge-m3 pulled. Embed our whole materials catalog into postgres so we can do similarity search on it later.
evals.expected_output: Exports RAG_MCP_OLLAMA_URL=http://gpu-box.lan:11434, verifies the model via /api/tags before running, then runs embed_materials.sh (which wraps backfill_embedding.sh) landing one 1024-dim vector per material row into chunk_embeddings via the postgres-vector sink.
